name: JL-002 Repeat5
authorization: Five more complete repetitions of the same 96 cases, retaining all results; combined cap GBP 5; originals untouched.
order: Same frozen case, arm and perspective order each repeat; serial runs and serial calls; fresh case/arm histories.
source: Exact JL-002-R1 adapter, arm functions, scorer, cases, prompts, answer key and protocol copies.
comparison: Each new repeat separately versus original; primary 64 distinct clean cases; all 96 secondary; same favorable-screen criteria; report all signs, ties, reversals, controls, abstentions, failures, agreement and cost.

outputs: Retain full request/response logs and sealed predictions per repeat. Do not inspect scores or tune between runs. Stop all repeats on first transport/contract error, budget guard or preservation failure; no automatic repair/resume.
historical_budget_note: Includes JL-001 and the complete combined JL-002-R1 once, including its original rejected response. This is stricter than capping only the five new repeats.
global_budget: Reserve full default context before each dispatch, durably log; settle to reported validated usage at GBP 2/USD; retain full uncertain reservations and halt. One exclusive batch, no resume, no concurrency.
